# Pesher Habakkuk Column 8 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** 1QpHab (Cave 1), Col. 8 | **Condition:** Well preserved; contains famous Hab 2:3-4 passage

---

**8:1** "And as for the phrase, 'so that the one who reads it may run' (Hab 2:2b) —

**8:2** its interpretation concerns the Teacher of Righteousness, to whom God

**8:3** made known all the mysteries of the words of His servants the prophets.

**8:4** 'For the vision is yet for an appointed time;

**8:5** it testifies of the end and does not lie' (Hab 2:3a).

**8:6** Its interpretation: the final age will be prolonged

**8:7** and will exceed all that the prophets said,

**8:8** for the mysteries of God are wonderful.

**8:9** 'If it tarries, wait for it; for it will surely

**8:10** come and will not delay' (Hab 2:3b).

**8:11** Its interpretation concerns the men of truth,

**8:12** the doers of the Torah, whose hands do not grow slack

**8:13** from the service of truth, even when the final age is prolonged for them.

**8:14** For all the appointed times of God will come in their due course,

**8:15** as He decreed for them in the mysteries of His wisdom.

**8:16** 'Behold, the one whose soul is not upright within him — but the righteous

**8:17** shall live by his faithfulness' (Hab 2:4). Its interpretation concerns all who observe the Torah in the House of Judah, whom God will deliver from the house of judgment because of their suffering and their faithfulness to the Teacher of Righteousness.

---
*SOPHIA notes: Column 8 covers Hab 2:2-4. This consensus translation harmonizes the best renderings from EMET, LOGOS, and PNEUMA. The pesher format — alternating biblical quotation and sectarian interpretation — is preserved throughout. Key sectarian titles maintained: Teacher of Righteousness, Wicked Priest, Man of the Lie, Kittim, Spouter of the Lie. "Interpretation" for pesher (per LOGOS). Lacunae [...] are genuine manuscript gaps. See disagreement log for resolution details.*
